validator.source_text:
<?ui-args --schema urn:example:custom=tests/fixtures/extension-example.xsd?>
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0"
       xmlns:c="urn:example:custom"
       initial="a">
  <state id="a">
    <onentry><c:mark value="not-an-integer"/></onentry>
    <transition event="go" target="b"/>
  </state>
  <final id="b"/>
</scxml>

primary.message: Invalid int value 'not-an-integer': invalid digit found in string

notes: the schema registered for `urn:example:custom` rejects this under XML Schema constraint `cvc-datatype-valid`
diagnostics.help: use a value in the datatype's lexical form
